quarterly_data.quarter: Xcel Energy press release: Xcel Energy, SEMCO ENERGY Gas Company and Upper Peninsula (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Xcel Energy announced the sale of its Michigan operations: the natural gas operations to SEMCO ENERGY Gas Company and the electric operations to Upper Peninsula Power Company (UPPCO). If approved by regulators, Xcel's 6,000 natural gas customers and 9,000 electric customers in Gogebic and Ontonagon counties will transition to the buyers; the companies expect the transaction to close in 2027, after required state and federal regulatory approvals. Karl Hoesly (president of Xcel Energy-Wisconsin and Michigan): Xcel 'continues to invest heavily in Wisconsin and across its other territories'.
quarterly_data.figure: 6,000 natural gas customers and 9,000 electric customers; close expected in 2027
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: buyer of the Michigan natural gas operations (the electric operations go to Upper Peninsula Power Company)
